changes: Separate confirmed manuscript saves from recovery cleanup/update failures; ancillary recovery errors no longer masquerade as failed manuscript writes.

Validate returned path, content, revision, BOM and metadata before accepting a save receipt. On ambiguous transport, invalid JSON or server failure, perform one bounded read-only verification without replaying the write.
Advance the editor base only for an exact matching saved version; preserve newer input and flag differing/unknown disk results honestly.
Carry unconfirmed/conflicting save state through undo, save controls, navigation, unload and safe-exit guards instead of mistaking an old cache match for saved data.
Explicit manual recovery remains available for verification/merge even when automatic recovery is off; it does not enable automatic recovery or write Canon.
Older recovery acknowledgments no longer claim that newer input is recovered. Verified-readback statistics only invalidate existing views and never create save events.

47 unique isolated headless-browser scenarios passed: 18 receipt/format/safety flows, 12 leave-dialog regressions, 15 safe-exit regressions and 2 confirmed-save/cleanup-failure combinations. No model calls.

Local Preview / PARTIAL. Native GUI/physical IME/DPI/voice/real cloud AI not newly verified. No new dependencies, Agent, data format, migration or permission. No publication, shortcut or real-data-location change.
runtime_validation: Preview / PARTIAL: see the current delivery evidence; headless browser, local checks, real Codex/MCP and packaged workers are separate gates. No native GUI/IME/DPI acceptance is claimed.
features: Character assistants, Python SDK and Codex MCP reuse one typed Action Registry and existing domain services.
On-demand Python Control uses genuine CPython WASI in a bounded owned subprocess, without host project mounts, network or shell.
Real frontend receipts support chapter navigation, pinned references, layouts and actual editor state.
Project/persona-scoped scripts, output history, AI task provenance and explicit read-only result handoffs.
Existing Codex login, concrete models and supported effort/context controls; real task events, result reading, cancellation and supported live steering.
Frozen author confirmations remain valid after a model or Python turn ends; scripts are never automatically replayed.
Source and binary candidates exclude private manuscripts, credentials, conversation history and character assets.
Preview: the action catalog covers designated workflows, not every application operation; new controls primarily support Chinese and English.
